shared_elements: low-relief carving with figures in strict profile
quadruped animals in profile facing right
procession of human figures accompanying animals
animals overlapping one another to suggest a group
detailed patterned rendering of hair and animal coat
justification: Both show a rightward-moving profile procession in low relief combining human figures with overlapping quadrupeds along a ground line, with hair and beards rendered as regular patterned masses in the same profile convention. However, A depicts a peaceful tribute-like file of attendants leading horned rams beside a stylised tree, while B depicts a harnessed horse team drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with a rider and a trampled prone body — a martial scene with vehicle and trampling relationships absent in A.
